title: Replace a tradesperson certificate
summary: You can apply for a replacement tradesperson certificate if your current certificate is damaged, lost, or stolen, by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro: If you have a tradesperson certificate, but it's been damaged, lost or stolen, you can apply for a replacement at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You have a tradesperson certificate that is damaged, lost, or stolen.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit'
Your personal details and certificate number

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it with your payment at a service centre.

external_links.text: Building or renovating a home – Building Commission NSW
Building, trade and specialist licences and registrations – Building Commission NSW

internal_links.text: Add your digital tradesperson certificate to the Service NSW app
Change the details on a tradesperson certificate

faqs.q: What do I need to replace my tradesperson certificate?
faqs.a: You need the PDF form, 'Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit', your personal details and certificate number, and payment.

faqs.q: Where can I apply for a replacement certificate?
faqs.a: You must apply for a replacement at a Service NSW Centre.
